newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates ends down on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates ends down on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates ended down on Thursday amid surplus liquidity and dealers said the market might open around similar levels on Friday.
The overnight market opened higher amid expectation of tight liquidity and offers were quoted around 19 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Later the rates fell to 17 percent as the market realised there were enough funds and deals were struck at eight percent near the closing hour, he said.
